instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value is continually redefined, and then tells me again that the work's value is continually redefined.
instances.why: Both lines state the same abstract property of the work — that its meaning is subject to ongoing redefinition — in the same register, sharing the root 'redefin-'; neither names a mechanism, a physical change, or a change for a particular audience that the other does not. Line 16 already supplied the mechanism register and line 20 the collector register, so these two only re-word the conclusion they jointly reach. Keep 21, which at least adds 'indeterminate' and names value and meaning as the subject; cut or re-pitch 17.
